recognize_zh: CD20 染色只在散在的大型非典型細胞呈強棕色膜陽性，這些細胞核大、形狀不規則，周圍大量小淋巴球與組織球為陰性，幾乎沒有小 B 細胞；少數大型 B 細胞散布於非 B 細胞背景，是 T 細胞/組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的典型免疫型態。
features: Scattered large atypical cells with strong membranous CD20 staining
Positive cells have large oval to irregular vesicular nuclei, some multilobated
Large B cells are dispersed singly or in loose groups, not in sheets
Paucity of CD20-positive small B cells in the background
Numerous CD20-negative small lymphocytes and histiocytes with oval to elongated nuclei
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows strong membranous staining of scattered, singly dispersed large atypical cells with large irregular vesicular nuclei. The background small lymphocytes and histiocytes are negative, with a notable paucity of small B cells. These large B cells comprise a minority of the infiltrate within a T-cell- and histiocyte-rich background. Findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NLPHL LP cells are CD20+ but lie in nodules rich in small CD20+ B cells with CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks.
Reed-Sternberg cells are CD20-negative or weak and heterogeneous, with CD30/CD15 positivity.
DLBCL NOS shows sheets of CD20+ large cells rather than scattered large B cells comprising a small minority.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with bystander B blasts
ddx.vs: Bystander B blasts are often EBER+ and accompany atypical clonal T cells with aberrant phenotype.
